why: bin/cmd/deletegate ALLOWS a delete under the instance root when the remove command sits inside a quoted string right after a quote, e.g. python3 -c "import os; os.system('rm -rf ~/.cairn/foo')" (rc 0); the same command after ';', after '(', or bare is REFUSED (rc 2). Found by builder 2026-10-11 while proving 76d35575aead (it moved its proof example to a space-before form to fit today's regex); re-measured by cc0 with the probe the same day. The gate's premise is that a delete under the instance root is final.
